# Lior Gal Tax Advisory

> Lior Gal is an Israeli attorney (adv.) and CPA specializing in Israeli and international tax law: cross-border transactions, business restructuring (mergers, share exchanges, corporate splits), startup and high-tech taxation, tax rulings, and representation before the Israel Tax Authority. Ten years of experience inside the Israel Tax Authority (Capital Markets and Corporate Restructuring divisions) and at Meitar Law Offices. Based in Israel; works in Hebrew and English.

The site is bilingual: Hebrew pages at the site root, English pages under /en/. Each page links to its counterpart in the other language.

## Articles

- [הערכות שווי בשינויי מבנה (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/הערכות-שווי-בשינויי-מבנה.html): when a merger or spin-off requires an external expert valuation and when a management valuation is enough.
- [Valuations in Business Restructuring (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/valuations-in-business-restructuring.html)
- [יתרונות המיזוג (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/יתרונות-המיזוג.html): the main advantages of merging two companies after an acquisition - cost savings, loss offsetting, shareholder balances and retained earnings.
- [The Advantages of a Merger (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/advantages-of-a-merger.html)
- [שלד בורסאי (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/שלד-בורסאי.html): going public through a merger with a listed company or public shell, and the choice between a Section 103K merger and a Section 104H share exchange for deferring the tax.
- [Shell Company Mergers (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/shell-company-mergers.html)
- [היפוך שרוול (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/היפוך-שרוול.html): points to consider in an Israeli "flip" to a US parent - US CFC/NCTI/PFIC rules, US estate tax, control and management, the green-track ruling's forms and trustee deposit, and employee options.
- [The Israeli Flip (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/the-flip.html)
- [רר"ל בשינויי מבנה (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/רווחים-ראויים-לחלוקה.html): how distributable earnings (Section 94B) are preserved in business restructurings - the guiding principle, where the rules sit (section, regulations or tax ruling only), and the Feller judgment on Section 104A.
- [Distributable Earnings in Business Restructuring (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/distributable-earnings-in-restructuring.html)
- [ציבור מעוניין (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/ציבור-מעוניין.html): the Israel Tax Authority's "interested public" arrangement in share exchanges - tax deferred until the actual sale with no trustee, versus the Section 104H 24/48-month deferral, and who it applies to.
- ["Interested Public" Arrangement (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/interested-public-arrangement.html)
- [תמורה במזומן במיזוג (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/תמורה-במזומן-במיזוג.html): cash consideration in a tax-exempt merger - the 49% limit and why it is not always the cap.
- [Cash Consideration in Mergers (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/cash-consideration-in-mergers.html)
- [טיפ מעשי בהיפוך שרוול (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/טיפ-מעשי-בהיפוך-שרוול.html): a practical tip for an Israeli flip under a green-track ruling - collecting all shareholder information once, in a single table built on the ruling's rights-holder table.
- [A Practical Tip for Handling an Israeli Flip (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/flip-practical-tip.html)
